storageEngines.consistencyMechanismDescription: Because 100% of the 554 source tables utilize the InnoDB transactional storage engine (0 MyISAM tables), point-in-time snapshot consistency is mathematically guaranteed via MySQL's Multi-Version Concurrency Control (MVCC) single-transaction read mechanism without table locks. The source database container remained completely idle on port 3307 during the entire extraction and verification pipeline.
